name: claudex
description: OpenAI Codex as a second-opinion teammate: parallel planning, plan critique, code/diff review, red-teaming, debugging collaboration, tradeoff analysis, and async background jobs. Codex runs in a read-only sandbox via the Codex CLI with your ChatGPT subscription.

args: CLAUDEX_ALLOWED_ROOTS=$(IFS=:; printf '%s' "$*"); export CLAUDEX_ALLOWED_ROOTS; PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.npm-global/bin:$PATH"; export PATH; exec uv run "${__dirname}/server/server.py"

allowed_roots.title: Allowed project folders
allowed_roots.description: Codex runs only inside these project folders (working-directory confinement; protected locations like ~/.ssh are always denied). Note: OS-level read sandboxing is on the roadmap — Codex retains user file permissions like any local dev tool. Leave empty for unrestricted power-user mode.
